exportGeographies: global — India is a design-services export/R&D-center hub, not a domestic-consumption story for this segment
market.domesticSlice: India is a major global supply base for this segment, not primarily a domestic buyer

structureFacts: Over 20% of the world's semiconductor design engineers are based in India, supporting global R&D centers for Intel, Qualcomm, MediaTek, Nvidia, and Texas Instruments — the same company Dyumnin's founder previously worked at as a Design Lead.
India's semiconductor landscape entered an accelerated growth phase from 2024, driven by India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) policy incentives and rising domestic demand.
As of May 2026, India has 431 active semiconductor design and manufacturing services companies — a crowded, well-established field, not an emerging niche.

adoptionStructure.note: A B2B services/consulting relationship market — demand is won through client engagements and reputation, not tenders or consumer purchase.

drivers: Technical credibility, often demonstrated through public open-source contributions and named engineering reputation rather than certifications.
Specialization depth in a specific tooling/methodology niche (e.g. cocotb-based verification) versus broad-service generalists.
Cost and talent-pool access — the core reason global majors have outsourced chip design/verification work to India since the mid-1980s.
customerValue.strongestPredictor: Demonstrated, checkable technical reputation (open-source contributions, conference talks, prior big-company pedigree) — especially important for a tiny boutique competing for attention against much larger, brand-name design-services firms.

steps: identify a fabless/chip company's design or verification need
propose a scoped engagement (design, IP, or verification service)
win via technical reputation and demonstrated expertise
deliver the design/verification service or IP
maintain deep expertise in specific tools/methodologies (e.g. cocotb, RAL)
publish open-source tools and contributions to build reputation
develop reusable IP (interconnect generators, verification IP)
stay current with client platforms (e.g. Xilinx/AMD FPGA families)
staff engagements (founder plus interns/collaborators)
scope and estimate project effort
deliver against client timelines
manage concurrent client engagements
onboard as a trusted technical partner
deliver against project milestones
support integration/handoff
maintain the relationship for repeat engagements
demand arises from a client's chip design/verification need
engagement scoped and contracted
delivered
recurring engagement or referral-driven new business
